description.describe_ch: 這門課程是針對研二及博士班學生設計之科目，課程著重在個體經濟學中常用到與迴歸相關的計量模型，並強調Individual-level及 Panel資料的實際使用。課程裡並教學生如何操作電腦軟體，是一門非常實用的課程，目的在提供學生足夠之基礎以利進一步之實證研究。
description.describe_eh: The course provides the foundation of microeconomics, the analysis of individual-level data on the economic behavior of individual or firms using regression approaches applied to cross-section and panel data. Students can learn important econometric skills that are helpful for their academic research in the future. This course is designed for the second year graduate students or the Ph.D. students. The practical use of statistic package and the data are emphasized in this course.
description.pre_subname: STAT1001統計學(一)、STAT1002統計學(二)、ECON3008計量經濟學

targets.describe_ch: 理解個體經濟理論所討論的實証議題並應用相關計量模型來驗證。
targets.describe_en: Understand important issues in Microeconomics and learn how to use econometric model and skills to verify and test.

targets.describe_ch: 應用相關計量方法透過資料進行分析，並由所得之實證結果歸納出適當結論。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use related econometric models to finish a study about economic activities, and draw appropriate conclusions from the empirical results.

targets.describe_ch: 能以書面或課堂討論與發表方式將所獲結果與同儕、及教師溝通。
targets.describe_en: Communicate results in written or class discussion and presentation to classmates, teaching and the instructor.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
本課程主要使用統計軟體為Stata，可連結至 逢甲 cloudapp 後直接使用。
 
The statistical package we will mainly use is Stata 16.0 or later version. Some useful websites for Stata learning are listed below.
http://www.stata.com/support/faqs/ 
http://fmwww.bc.edu/gstat/examples/wooldridge/wooldridge.html
http://www.cpc.unc.edu/research/tools/data_analysis/statatutorial/
http://data.princeton.edu/stata/
http://www.ats.ucla.edu/stat/stata/
 
線性代數:  楊睿中《統計學》：統計 / 計量經濟需要的線性代數
